messages.subject: Error while configuring LDAP for Shiny Server
parts:
I am getting the following error while trying to configure Shiny Server with LDAP
 Error in LDAP client: Error: 139759606667040:error:14082174:SSL routines:ssl3_check_cert_and_algorithm:dh key too small:../deps/openssl/openssl/ssl/s3_clnt.c:3635:

Please suggest how to go about this error

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Error while configuring LDAP for Shiny Server
parts:
This means your LDAP server is running with a vulnerable TLS configuration, so Shiny Server Pro (actually OpenSSL) is refusing to connect. You can learn more about the Logjam Attack and how to fix your LDAP server's configuration, at this helpful page (there's a section specifically on OpenLDAP, though you should read the overview section as well):
http://jfcarter.net/~jimc/documents/logjam-1507.html
